evidence: The paper applies a random forest model ("An R Package 'ranger' (ver. 0.13.1) (Wright and Ziegler 2017) was used to create a random forest model") but evaluates it solely on predictive accuracy using correlation coefficients. Results report frequency of outperformance versus a genomic prediction benchmark ("the random forest model outperformed GPG 155 out of 364 times"), not variable importance. Conclusions concern G × E capture and prediction accuracy, not feature ranking or magnitude: "the results suggest that our model can capture G × E, especially the latter growth period for the random forest model."
